items.title: Building an Ingest Safety Monitor for Your IIoT Pipeline in SQL | Tiger Data
items.summary: An industrial internet of things (IIoT) ingest pipeline can run for months without an error and then fall behind within hours of a load increase. Ingest safety is the distance between current write load and a ceiling measured by WAL volume, replica replay, dead rows, and forced checkpoints. Measure that distance every minute to get an alert.
